zh.title: 海軍陸戰隊12月將實彈操演 勁蜂一型攻擊無人機參訓
zh.summary: 海軍陸戰隊12月8日將於高雄左營海灘一帶實彈操演，勁蜂一型攻擊無人機參訓
body: 海軍陸戰隊預定12月8日在高雄左營海灘一帶實施「聯合作戰計畫演練實彈射擊」。中科院研製的勁蜂一型攻擊型無人機將投入此次操演，由兩棲偵搜大隊偵二中隊操作。
根據漁業署射擊通報資訊，海空域管制時間為下午4時至晚上8時，實際實彈射擊則預定於下午4時30分至晚上7時進行。此次演練所射擊的彈藥共超過5萬1000發。
中央社報導，預定參與操演的勁蜂一型具備光電與紅外線（EO/IR）設備，可在日間及夜間進行搜索。

en.title: Marine Corps to Use Attack Drone in December Live-Fire Drill
en.summary: The Marine Corps plans a December 8 live-fire drill in Kaohsiung with an attack drone.
body: The Marine Corps plans to hold a joint operational plan live-fire exercise around Zuoying Beach in Kaohsiung on December 8. An attack drone known as 勁蜂一型, developed by 中科院, is scheduled to take part and be operated by the amphibious reconnaissance unit’s Second Reconnaissance Squadron.

The Fisheries Agency’s firing notice lists sea and airspace control from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Live firing is scheduled from 4:30 p.m. to 7 p.m. The exercise is expected to use more than 51,000 rounds of ammunition.
CNA reported that the drone has electro-optical and infrared (EO/IR) equipment and can conduct searches by day and night.
